reserve.name: Maó old-town lanes and local shops
reserve.description: Explore the old-town lanes and small shops above the harbour, leaving time for a square-side pause. This is distinct from a harbour dinner and does not depend on a museum opening.

reserve.name: Calesfonts waterfront evening
reserve.description: Spend an early evening by the harbour, choosing an open terrace for a drink as the fishing port settles into its evening rhythm. No club event, private pier access or boat trip is included.

reserve.name: Es Mercadal village lunch pause
reserve.description: Allow time for an informal village lunch and a look at local bakeries or food shops. Choose open businesses on the day; this is not a fixed tasting or a farm reservation.

reserve.name: Sant Lluís whitewashed village afternoon
reserve.description: Wander the public lanes around the village centre for a slower-paced afternoon, pairing the whitewashed streets with a café stop. No paid monument or guided tour is implied.

reserve.name: El Pilar de la Mola village pause
reserve.area_name: El Pilar de la Mola village centre
reserve.description: Spend time in the village streets and choose an open café or craft shop. This remains a village outing outside the craft market's scheduled days; no market or lighthouse opening is promised.

reserve.name: Sant Ferran relaxed terrace evening
reserve.area_name: Sant Ferran de ses Roques centre
reserve.description: Return after dinner for a low-key drink on an open terrace and a village evening rather than a club night. Check any live programme separately; no event is included.

reserve.name: Migjorn slow coastal afternoon
reserve.area_name: Public beach areas along Platja de Migjorn
reserve.description: Choose an accessible public stretch of Migjorn for a relaxed afternoon, allowing time to sit by the sea instead of checking off several beaches. This is not a mapped end-to-end coastal route; conditions and access vary.

reserve.name: Formentera local-produce picnic stop
reserve.area_name: Sant Francesc food shops and permitted public picnic areas
reserve.description: Pick up local products from open village food shops for a simple picnic in a permitted public area. Respect protected-area rules, take litter away and use no fire; no fixed retailer, tasting or private access is included.
